_comment: Sensor → PhysicsDomain mapping for the geometric-to-binary repo. Each sensor declares which PhysicsDomain values its readings activate, plus an epistemic tag (epi) and confidence. This is the physics-side schema only. Drivers live in JinnZ2/Symbolic-sensor-suite. The .claims/Primitive format is owned elsewhere when canonized — this repo just declares which physics domains a sensor reading lights up so the morphism graph and physics_to_bridge_domain_map can route the observation downstream. Tier breakdown follows the sensing-stack proposal (tier 1 = solar+phone-minimal, tier 2 = adds spectrum, tier 3 = adds RF).

epi_taxonomy._comment: Mirrors the precedent set by JinnZ2/JinnZ2/Random-Thought-Ledger (provenance.confidence) and the user-proposed sensing framework. 'measured' = direct physical reading; 'measured_inferred_id' = direct reading whose meaning requires species/context inference; 'measured_needs_interpretation' = direct reading with no ground-truth label without further analysis.
epi_taxonomy.measured: Direct physical reading of a measurable physical quantity.
epi_taxonomy.measured_inferred_id: Reading is direct but identification of subject (species, individual) requires inference.
epi_taxonomy.measured_needs_interpretation: Reading is direct but spectral/contextual interpretation is needed before the value carries meaning.

_field_link._comment: How this file plugs into the rest of the stack. The chain is: sensor → physics_domains → (.fieldlink.json#physics_to_bridge_domain_map) → bridge_domains → Bridge encoder. Drivers/transmission/.claims live in other repos.
